# A test reaching into a component the one under test builds at run time --
# here one under an `if` over state -- names no one instance on a target that
# keeps state per instance, and is refused at the read. bubbletea keeps no
# state of an instance's own, so it splices the component where it is written
# and the read is the splice's; the interpreter reads the instance it mounted.

! sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stderr 'app.sngl:22:19: `#b` is built at run time on this target, so there is no one instance whose hits a test can reach'

! sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stderr 'app.sngl:22:19: `#b` is built at run time on this target'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

# html reaches a node of one by its id and copy, which the order of the page
# answers only where nothing else renders the id: here a second loop does.
! sngl test --platform=html twice.sngl
stderr 'twice.sngl:\d+:\d+: the page renders `#shown` outside badge, or badge at more than one site, so a test cannot tell which copy is which'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component bar node {
    var hits = 0
    button #btn(text="go", @click {
        hits = hits + 1
    })
}

component main node {
    var show = true
    vbox {
        if show {
            bar #b
        }
    }
}

func testReachesARuntimeInstance(t Test, c main) {
    if c.b != null {
        t.assert(c.b.hits == 0)
    }
}

window {
    main
}
-- twice.sngl --
import "sngl:test/browser"
import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

component other(label string) node {
    var seen = 0
    text #shown(value="other {label}:{seen}")
}

component badge(label string) node {
    var hits = 0
    text #shown(value="[{label}:{hits}]")
}

component main node {
    var names list[string] = ["a"]
    for var n = names {
        other #o(label=n)
    }
    for var n = names {
        badge #b(label=n)
    }
}

func testTheSecondLoopsCopy(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(browser.text(c.b[0].shown) == "[a:0]")
}

window {
    main
}
-- testrun/bubbletea/go/app.sngl/main/1 --

      "Passed": true
